messages:
lina: FYI the Go SDK publish is red on release/0.4.x. regen-check shows typegen 2.1.0 changed optional model fields to pointers. sample-apps unit tests are failing because they relied on zero-values.

brian: ugh. can you paste the diff? wondering if it's just marshaling or actual API surface change.

lina: snippet: ```go
// before
type User struct {
  Name string `json:\"name\"`
  Age  int    `json:\"age\"` // optional, zero means unset in app tests
}
// after (typegen 2.1.0)
type User struct {
  Name string  `json:\"name\"`
  Age  *int    `json:\"age,omitempty\"`
}
```

omar: that is a breaking change for Go consumers. Pointer vs value changes equality, JSON marshaling, and lots of internal sample app logic. This should have been a major or at least a documented minor with migration notes.

devex-bot: regen-check workflow failed: 18 files mismatched. CI link: https://ci.internal/1791124000/regen. Release publish blocked.

brian: two immediate options: 1) revert typegen bump on release branch (quick), 2) add a compatibility shim in codegen for go to keep previous shapes for patch releases. Which is less risky?

lina: revert is fastest but we'd have to reintroduce the change on next major. Compatibility shim keeps patch path clean but feels like layering complexity into codegen. I'm leaning shim for the release branch to avoid churn for users.

omar: agree shim. Also need a clear changelog entry and a policy note: typegen behavior affecting language-specific shapes must follow semver policy. We lost visibility here.

brian: I'll draft the shim: detect typegen optional-is-pointer flag and emit non-pointer form for Go if in release channel. PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/codegen/pull/2401

lina: also found a failing sample app: quickstart/go-todo uses equality checks on Age. Tests expect `Age == 0` to mean unset. Should add a note in sample README about migration if we ever flip.

release-bot: publish blocked for @redwood/go-sdk 0.4.1 (reason: regen diffs).

brian: local test: `make regen LANGS=go` -> fixed generated structs, unit tests in sample-apps pass locally. Pushed branch with shim + regen.

lina: saw the PR; also like to add a tiny changelog under Unreleased: "fix(go): preserve non-pointer optional fields for patch releases (regen deterministic)".

omar: after we merge, let's add an automated check in the regen CI to detect pointer-introductions for go and flag as semver-risk. We should also add this to the release checklist: run `make regen LANGS=all` and snapshot diffs.

devex-bot: CI retriggered for release/0.4.x (build #1791124102). regen-compare shows 0 diffs after merge on brian's branch.

brian: merging the shim now. Will coordinate with release team for a patch publish.

lina: thanks. small follow-ups: (1) issue to define typegen semver guidance + language-shape policy, (2) add sample-app regression tests to the regen suite so onboarding examples don't bit-rot.

omar: filing both issues. Also flagging the typegen repo to add a breaking-change checklist before releases.

release-bot: publish job started for @redwood/go-sdk 0.4.1.

brian: publish succeeded. Docs site rebuilt and sample-app CI green. Closing the loop. :tada:

devex-bot: thread closed by brian (action: publish-complete)
